scams.name: Melaka QR-Code Receipt Scam — Fake Payment Proof at Retailers
scams.description: At a Jonker Walk satay stall, you scan the table-side QR sticker and tap RM35 — but the sticker is a fake pasted over the legitimate one and your money goes to a mule account. NST 'Fake QR receipts, real money: Couple's cheating spree ends in arrest' (April 21 2026, article 1423507) detailed the case — a Melaka Tengah couple hit petrol stations and grocery stores for close to RM3,000; NST also logged a RM25,270 QR-code Harumanis case the same month. Always verify the payee name on your banking app before tapping confirm — a legitimate Jonker stall shows a registered business name. Pay cash (RM10 / RM20 notes) for stall transactions under RM50. Never accept a screenshot as payment proof — only a real-time push notification on your own banking app counts.
scams.avoidance: Verify payee name on banking app before confirming — not just the amount Pay cash (RM10 / RM20) for stall transactions under RM50 NEVER DuitNow-transfer on behalf of a stranger offering 'cash back' Peel-test QR stickers that look freshly stuck — legitimate ones are laminated Only a push notification on your own bank app is real proof of payment National Scam Response Centre 997; MOTAC tourist line 1300-88-5050
scams.location: Jonker Street/Walk night-market stalls, 7-Eleven & KK Super Mart outlets across Melaka Tengah, petrol stations, Taman Rempah jetty ticket counter, Menara Taming Sari, Dataran Pahlawan food court, Mahkota Parade retail
scams.tldr: Melaka's fastest-growing 2026 tourist-adjacent fraud is the falsified-QR-payment-receipt scam, where buyers show merchants a doctored DuitNow/Maybank/Touch 'n Go screenshot instead of actually paying.

scams.name: Melaka Trishaw (Beca) Bait-and-Switch Overcharge
scams.description: At the Stadthuys / Red Square taxi stand, an LED-bedecked Hello Kitty trishaw quotes RM50 for a heritage-loop ride. On arrival the rider demands RM80, then RM150, claiming 'per person' or 'extra for music.' The Star 'Melaka looks into claims of trishaw rider overcharging tourist' (April 15 2026) covered the case — Majlis Bandaraya Melaka Bersejarah launched a probe after a Threads user 'Yasmin_aishah' was billed RM80 against an RM50 quote. MBMB reaffirmed the OFFICIAL FARE is RM25–RM50 depending on route. Agree the total fare in writing before boarding, and confirm 'Jumlah semua, bukan satu orang?' (total, not per person). The Hello Kitty / Pikachu fleet is licensed but pricing varies — shop 2–3 riders. Grab is RM8–RM15 hotel-to-Jonker if you just need transport.
scams.avoidance: MBMB official fare RM25–RM50 — anything above RM50 for Stadthuys-to-Jonker loop is overcharging Agree total fare in writing (photo of fare card) BEFORE boarding Confirm 'Jumlah semua, bukan satu orang?' (total, not per person) Photograph rider + trishaw number plate if disputed on arrival Report to MBMB 06-282 9804 or Tourism Malaysia 1300-88-5050 Grab is RM8–RM15 for normal transport; use trishaws for photo-loops only
scams.location: Stadthuys / Red Square (Dutch Square) trishaw stand, Jonker Street / Jonker Walk night market entrance (Fri-Sun), Christ Church Melaka plaza, A'Famosa / St. Paul's Hill loop, Menara Taming Sari drop-off
scams.tldr: Melaka's LED-bedecked, music-blaring Hello Kitty / Pikachu / Elsa trishaws are the single most-photographed symbol of the UNESCO zone — and also the city's most-documented 2026 tourist-overcharge.

scams.name: Jonker Street Night-Market Food & Durian Overcharge
scams.description: At a menu-less Jonker Walk stall, you order fried rice and the bill is RM35 — the local rate is RM10–RM15. A satay celup vendor doesn't post the per-stick rate and bills RM3–RM5 a stick instead of the RM1–RM1.30 charged at Capitol Satay or McQuek's. Worst is durian: 'RM80/kg' looks fair, but the seller weighs the whole 2 kg fruit (husk and all) for RM160 when the flesh inside is only 300 grams. Refuse any stall without a visible printed price list — MBMB enforcement actively tickets non-compliant vendors. Ask 'berapa semua?' (how much in total?) before ordering. For durian, demand the seller cut and weigh the flesh in front of you. Photograph the menu before ordering. Cap stall meals at RM15–RM20 per person — anything higher means you're in a tourist-trap stall.
scams.avoidance: Refuse stalls without a VISIBLE printed price list — MBMB requires display Confirm per-piece OR per-kg for durian — weigh flesh in front of you Satay celup: check per-stick rate on wall board (legitimate RM1–RM1.30) Photo the price board BEFORE ordering; ask 'berapa semua?' up front Cap stall meals at RM15–RM20 per person for street food MBMB hotline 06-282 9804; Tourism Malaysia 1300-88-5050
scams.location: Jonker Street / Jonker Walk night market (Jalan Hang Jebat) Friday-Sunday, Jonker Street Hawker Centre, durian stalls along Jalan Tokong, roast-duck stalls at the Jonker Walk entrance, satay celup strip near Kampung Banda Kaba
scams.tldr: Jonker Street / Jonker Walk night market (Friday 6 PM-midnight, Saturday-Sunday) is Melaka's headline tourist dining strip and the city's most-documented 2024-2026 food-overcharge zone.

scams.name: Melaka River Cruise Unofficial-Ticket & Tout Overcharge
scams.description: Walking toward Taman Rempah jetty for the Melaka River Cruise, a man at a riverside cafe waves you over: 'VIP skip-the-line tickets, RM75 per adult.' The official foreigner adult fare on visitmelaka.com.my is RM30 (RM25 MyKad). His 'voucher' is an expired Klook screenshot or a forged QR. Variants: 'cruise sold out, take my private boat for RM100' (the cruise rarely sells out except during school holidays); a 'combined cruise + Taming Sari + trishaw' package at RM200 where every element is a fraction of that at the official counters. Buy only at Jeti Taman Rempah or Dataran Muara Sungai Melaka counters, or online at ticket.melakarivercruise.my. The only boats are the official blue-and-white fleet.
scams.avoidance: Official fares foreign adult RM30 / MyKad RM25 / child RM15 — buy ONLY at posted counters or ticket.melakarivercruise.my IGNORE all touts offering 'VIP' / 'skip-the-line' / 'better boat' — the fleet is uniform blue-and-white Refuse hotel-desk resales above RM30/adult; refuse street-vendor PDF vouchers Cruise rarely sells out — 'sold out' pressure is almost always fake Approach Taman Rempah via Jalan Persisiran Bunga Raya, not side alleys Taman Rempah 06-286 1530; Muara 06-286 1531; Tourism Malaysia 1300-88-5050
scams.location: Jeti Taman Rempah (Jalan Persisiran Bunga Raya, 75100 Melaka), Dataran Muara Sungai Melaka jetty, tout approaches along Jalan Laksamana Cheng Ho, hotel concierge desks in Banda Hilir, Grab drop-off decoys near Kampung Morten
scams.tldr: The Melaka River Cruise is the UNESCO zone's flagship paid attraction.

scams.name: Melaka Costumed-Character Beggar (Spider-Man/Frog) & Child-Exploitation Scam
scams.description: Near Christ Church plaza an adult in a Spider-Man costume poses for photos alongside a small girl, also in Spider-Man costume. After your photo a 'tip' demand starts at RM20 per person and escalates to RM50–RM100. The Star ''Spider-Man' suspect investigated for using young girl to beg in Melaka' (February 9 2026) ran the canonical case — authorities intercepted an adult operating alongside a 7-year-old from Terengganu. Rakyat Post and Bernama covered the same Kalsom enforcement intervention; SCMP picked it up internationally. MBMB-licensed buskers display fixed tips of RM2–RM5, not RM20–RM100. If a costumed adult is working alongside a child soliciting money, walk away and report to MBMB (06-282 9804). Don't take the photo in the first place — posing triggers the demand.
scams.avoidance: NEVER pay costumed characters without a POSTED rate card — licensed Melaka buskers display RM2–RM5 tips only Do NOT pose for the photo in the first place — it triggers the demand If an adult is working with a young child for donations, walk away + report MBMB enforcement 06-282 9804; JKM child-welfare line 15999 Donate via UNICEF Malaysia / Yayasan Chow Kit — NOT cash to street handlers Keep phones in zipped bags — costumed-character photos are phone-snatch preludes
scams.location: Christ Church Melaka plaza, Stadthuys / Red Square (Dutch Square), Jonker Street / Jonker Walk entrance, Dataran Pahlawan, A'Famosa fort steps, river walk along Jalan Laksamana
scams.tldr: Melaka's heritage zone hosts one of Malaysia's most-documented 2025-2026 child-exploitation-via-costumed-begging schemes, which exploded into national news in February 2026.

scams.name: Melaka Fake-Donation & Charity-Solicitor Scam
scams.description: At Christ Church plaza or Kampung Kling Mosque, a man with a clipboard and laminated 'building fund' photos approaches: 'donate for the mosque restoration.' Or a 'deaf-mute' card asks for RM50–RM100. Or a WhatsApp forward circulates with PDRM Melaka 'flood relief' branding. FMT 'Fake fundraising appeal circulating on WhatsApp, Melaka cops warn' (April 22 2026) ran the public PDRM warning — state police chief Datuk Dzulkhairi Mukhtar explicitly denied police are running any fundraising. Real Malaysian religious and charitable collections happen inside religious buildings with registered permits, not on the sidewalk. Refuse every clipboard, every 'deaf-mute' card, every QR sticker on a roadside donation box. To actually give, use Yayasan Chow Kit, MERCY Malaysia, or UNICEF Malaysia.
scams.avoidance: NEVER give cash to street solicitors — legitimate Malaysian charities collect inside buildings with permit numbers 'Saya tak bagi — telefon polis' (I don't give — call the police) and walk PDRM Melaka runs NO public fundraising (Dzulkhairi Mukhtar, April 2026) Registered charities only: MERCY Malaysia, UNICEF Malaysia, Tabung Haji Refuse 'deaf-mute' clipboard approaches — a known Peninsular template Verify any WhatsApp appeal via official Polis Melaka Facebook before transferring
scams.location: Christ Church Melaka plaza, St. Paul's Hill, Kampung Kling Mosque, Cheng Hoon Teng Temple (Harmony Street), A'Famosa fort entrance, Mahkota Parade, Dataran Pahlawan, Melaka Sentral bus terminal, Jonker Walk entrance
